scenarios.name: Controlled Election
scenarios.description: Saied holds managed elections with pre-approved candidates. Low turnout, result predetermined.

scenarios.name: Postponement
scenarios.description: Election postponed citing security concerns or economic emergency.

scenarios.name: Opposition Surge
scenarios.description: Unexpected mobilisation forces competitive election. Outcome unpredictable.

scenarios.name: No Election / Crisis
scenarios.description: Systemic collapse pre-empts electoral cycle entirely.
